info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Cross Channel Interactive Help-spec
info.description: The Cross Channel Interactive Help API facilitates the creation of dynamic help specifications across various banking channels. This service allows developers to define and submit interactive help content that enhances user experience by providing tailored guidance in real-time. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions looking to improve customer support and user engagement through contextual assistance. Whether for applications, websites, or chatbots, this API serves as a vital tool for delivering comprehensive and accessible help content.

post.summary: Initiates an interactive help session for cross-channel support.
post.description: This operation allows users to begin an interactive help session across multiple channels. It leverages real-time data to provide guided assistance tailored to user needs, improving engagement and effectiveness in problem-solving.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate interactive help via the cross-channel communication system. It requires specific parameters to effectively communicate the user's request for assistance.
